```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Data: one row per Pennsylvania county and year.
dat <- read.csv(
  "data/processed/pa_diabetes_mortality_age_adjusted_2018_2025.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dat$county_fips <- sprintf("%05s", dat$county_fips)
dat$year <- as.integer(dat$year)

# Pennsylvania annual trend against a fixed 2018-2019 reference.
state_trend <- read.csv(
  "data/processed/pa_diabetes_state_trend_2018_2025.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Age-specific deaths and populations for the age-pattern panel.
age_deaths <- read.csv(
  "data/intermediate/pa_diabetes_deaths_by_age_2018_2025.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
age_population <- read.csv(
  "data/intermediate/pa_county_population_by_age_2018_2025.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
age_data <- left_join(
  age_deaths,
  age_population,
  by = c("year", "county_fips", "county_name", "age_group")
)
age_levels <- c("0-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85+")
age_data$age_group <- factor(age_data$age_group, levels = age_levels)

# County boundaries are read once, outside the reactive expressions.
pa_map <- readRDS("data/processed/pa_counties.rds") |>
  st_transform(4326)
pa_map$county_fips <- as.character(pa_map$county_fips)

county_names <- sort(unique(dat$county_name))

# Statewide trend reads no input and is computed once.
pa_year <- state_trend |>
  transmute(
    year = year,
    SMR = fixed_reference_smr,
    area = "Pennsylvania"
  )

# Fixed Exercise 4 risk classes: colours keep the same meaning.
risk_breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 2 / 3, 0.9, 1 / 0.9, 1.5, 2, Inf)
```

Dashboard
=====================================

Column {.sidebar data-width=240}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r inputs}
selectInput(
  "county",
  "Pennsylvania county",
  choices = county_names,
  selected = "Allegheny"
)

sliderInput(
  "years",
  "Years",
  min = min(dat$year),
  max = max(dat$year),
  value = range(dat$year),
  step = 1,
  sep = ""
)
```

Pick a county, then drag either end of the year slider. The map, selected
county outline, time-series band, and summary card respond.

> **Coverage:** all 67 Pennsylvania counties, 2018-2025 (536 county-year
> records). Every county-year has an observed diabetes-death count.

```{r reactive}
# Observed and expected deaths by county for the selected years.
by_county <- reactive({
  dat |>
    filter(between(year, input$years[1], input$years[2])) |>
    group_by(county_fips, county_name) |>
    summarise(
      Observed = sum(deaths),
      Expected = sum(expected_annual_age),
      Person_years = sum(population),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      SMR = Observed / Expected,
      Rate = 1e5 * Observed / Person_years
    )
})
```

> SMR = observed deaths divided by age-adjusted expected deaths. A value above
> 1 means more deaths than expected under the Pennsylvania reference.

> The observations are aggregated county-year counts, not individual records
> or death locations.

Column {data-width=520}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Age-adjusted SMR by county, selected years

```{r map}
renderLeaflet({
  d <- left_join(
    pa_map,
    by_county(),
    by = c("county_fips", "county_name")
  )

  pal <- colorBin(
    rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
    domain = d$SMR,
    bins = risk_breaks
  )

  leaflet(d) |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(SMR),
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      color = "#7a8793",
      weight = 0.8,
      label = ~sprintf(
        "%s County: SMR %.2f (%s observed, %.1f expected)",
        county_name,
        SMR,
        format(Observed, big.mark = ","),
        Expected
      ),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 2,
        color = "black",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = filter(d, county_name == input$county),
      fill = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      weight = 4
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      "bottomright",
      pal = pal,
      values = ~SMR,
      title = paste0(
        "Age-adjusted SMR<br>",
        input$years[1], "-", input$years[2]
      ),
      labFormat = labelFormat(digits = 2),
      opacity = 0.85
    )
})
```

> Red counties have more deaths than expected; blue counties have fewer. The
> black outline marks the county selected in the sidebar. Map classes stay
> fixed when the period changes.

Column {data-width=480}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Observed deaths {data-height=105}

```{r observed-box}
renderValueBox({
  one <- filter(by_county(), county_name == input$county)

  valueBox(
    value = format(one$Observed, big.mark = ","),
    caption = sprintf(
      "%s County diabetes deaths, %s-%s",
      input$county,
      input$years[1],
      input$years[2]
    ),
    icon = "fa-heartbeat",
    color = "danger"
  )
})
```

### Age-adjusted SMR {data-height=105}

```{r summary-box}
renderValueBox({
  one <- filter(by_county(), county_name == input$county)

  valueBox(
    value = sprintf("%.2f", one$SMR),
    caption = sprintf(
      "%s observed / %.1f expected; Pennsylvania reference = 1",
      format(one$Observed, big.mark = ","),
      one$Expected
    ),
    icon = "fa-balance-scale",
    color = "primary"
  )
})
```

### Fixed-reference SMR by year {data-height=255}

```{r timeseries}
renderPlotly({
  county_label <- paste0(input$county, " County")

  one <- dat |>
    filter(county_name == input$county) |>
    transmute(
      year = year,
      SMR = fixed_reference_smr,
      area = county_label
    )

  cols <- setNames(
    c("black", "#B2182B"),
    c("Pennsylvania", county_label)
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    bind_rows(pa_year, one),
    aes(year, SMR, colour = area, group = area)
  ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = input$years[1] - 0.5,
      xmax = input$years[2] + 0.5,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = "grey90"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2025) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Fixed-reference SMR", colour = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

> The grey band marks the selected period. The dashed line at 1 represents as
> many deaths as expected under the fixed 2018-2019 reference.

### Age-pattern interpretation {data-height=115}

> The bars compare the selected county with Pennsylvania for the selected
> years. Mortality rises strongly with age, which is why age adjustment is
> necessary for county comparisons.

### Mortality by age group {data-height=500}

```{r age-plot}
renderPlotly({
  selected_years <- age_data |>
    filter(between(year, input$years[1], input$years[2]))

  county_age <- selected_years |>
    filter(county_name == input$county) |>
    group_by(age_group) |>
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths),
      population = sum(population),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      rate = 1e5 * deaths / population,
      area = paste0(input$county, " County")
    )

  pa_age <- selected_years |>
    group_by(age_group) |>
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths),
      population = sum(population),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      rate = 1e5 * deaths / population,
      area = "Pennsylvania"
    )

  age_plot_data <- bind_rows(pa_age, county_age)
  age_colours <- setNames(
    c("#17324d", "#b2182b"),
    c("Pennsylvania", paste0(input$county, " County"))
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    age_plot_data,
    aes(
      age_group,
      rate,
      fill = area,
      text = sprintf(
        "%s<br>Age: %s<br>Deaths: %s<br>Rate: %.1f per 100,000",
        area,
        age_group,
        format(deaths, big.mark = ","),
        rate
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = age_colours) +
    labs(
      x = "Age group",
      y = "Deaths per 100,000 person-years",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 30, l = 10)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
    layout(
      margin = list(l = 80, r = 20, t = 25, b = 85),
      xaxis = list(automargin = TRUE),
      yaxis = list(automargin = TRUE)
    )
})
```

Methods and Sources
=====================================

Column {data-width=1000}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### About these data

- **Outcome:** underlying-cause diabetes deaths, 2018-2025, by county and year.
- **Population at risk:** residents of all 67 Pennsylvania counties.
- **Expected deaths:** indirect standardization using five age groups (0-44,
  45-64, 65-74, 75-84, and 85+).
- **Map measure:** observed divided by annual age-adjusted expected deaths,
  pooled across the selected period.
- **Time-series measure:** annual SMR against fixed pooled Pennsylvania
  2018-2019 age-specific rates.
- **Interaction:** the reader chooses a county and period; the panels respond.
- **Limitation:** mortality measures fatal burden rather than diabetes
  prevalence; county patterns do not establish individual or causal effects.

The complete official source list is stored in
`data/processed/data_sources.csv`.
